description: Structured eval definitions for the Serverless Application Repository Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across SAR publishing topologies (private app with SAM template and cross-account application policy, public app with LICENSE requirement, nested application composition requiring CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND, semantic version update from 1.0.0 to 1.1.0, missing LICENSE prerequisite failure for public sharing). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Private SAR application with SAM template and cross-account application policy
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — private SAR app, SAM transform declared, README + LICENSE present, semantic version 1.0.0, application policy grants consumer account 999999999999, CAPABILITY_IAM required
eval_cases.prompt: Publish a serverless application named s3-file-processor. SAM template with Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31, a Lambda function (AWS::Serverless::Function) with S3 event trigger, and an S3 bucket parameter. README.md present. LICENSE present (Apache-2.0). Semantic version 1.0.0. Private sharing — grant consumer account 999999999999 deploy permission. Author: Jacky Chan. Labels: s3, lambda, event-driven. Region us-east-1. Publisher account 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SAR_APPLICATION: s3-file-processor (1.0.0)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] SAM template: template.yaml (Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31)
  [✓] README.md: present
  [✓] LICENSE: present (Apache-2.0)
  [✓] Packaging: sam package → S3 artifact
  [✓] Semantic version: 1.0.0
  [✓] Sharing: Private+Policy (granted to 999999999999)
  [✓] Application policy: PutApplicationPolicy → Principal: 999999999999, Action: CreateCloudFormationChangeSet
  [✓] Capabilities: CAPABILITY_IAM
  [✓] Author profile: Jacky Chan, labels: s3, lambda, event-driven
  [✓] Application ARN: arn:aws:serverlessrepo:us-east-1:123456789012:apps/s3-file-processor
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws serverlessrepo get-application --application-id arn:aws:serverlessrepo:us-east-1:123456789012:apps/s3-file-processor --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Public SAR application with LICENSE requirement and implicit policy
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — public SAR app, LICENSE required for public sharing, application policy implicit (public = anyone), CAPABILITY_IAM, semantic version 1.2.0
eval_cases.prompt: Publish a serverless application named realtime-stream-processor as PUBLIC. SAM template with an AWS::Serverless::Function processing Kinesis events. README.md present. LICENSE present (MIT). Semantic version 1.2.0. Public sharing — anyone can discover and deploy. Author: Jacky Chan. Labels: kinesis, lambda, streaming. Region us-east-1. Publisher account 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SAR_APPLICATION: realtime-stream-processor (1.2.0)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] SAM template: template.yaml (Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31)
  [✓] README.md: present
  [✓] LICENSE: present (MIT) — required for PUBLIC sharing
  [✓] Semantic version: 1.2.0
  [✓] Sharing: Public (anyone can discover and deploy)
  [✓] Application policy: implicit (public = open)
  [✓] Capabilities: CAPABILITY_IAM
  [✓] Author profile: Jacky Chan, labels: kinesis, lambda, streaming
  [✓] Application ARN: arn:aws:serverlessrepo:us-east-1:123456789012:apps/realtime-stream-processor
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws serverlessrepo get-application --application-id arn:aws:serverlessrepo:us-east-1:123456789012:apps/realtime-stream-processor --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Parent SAR application with nested child applications requiring CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — parent app nests two child SAR apps via AWS::Serverless::Application, CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND required, child ARNs cited
eval_cases.prompt: Publish a parent serverless application named data-pipeline-suite. The SAM template nests two child SAR applications: arn:aws:serverlessrepo:us-east-1:123456789012:apps/s3-file-processor (version 1.0.0) and arn:aws:serverlessrepo:us-east-1:123456789012:apps/kinesis-forwarder (version 2.0.0). README.md present. LICENSE present (Apache-2.0). Semantic version 1.0.0. Private sharing. Author: Jacky Chan. Region us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SAR_APPLICATION: data-pipeline-suite (1.0.0)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] SAM template: template.yaml (Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31)
  [✓] Nested applications: s3-file-processor (1.0.0), kinesis-forwarder (2.0.0)
  [✓] Capabilities: CAPABILITY_IAM CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND
  [✓] Semantic version: 1.0.0
  [✓] Sharing: Private
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws serverlessrepo get-application --application-id arn:aws:serverlessrepo:us-east-1:123456789012:apps/data-pipeline-suite --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: SAR application version update from 1.0.0 to 1.1.0 (MINOR bump)
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — update existing app, new version 1.1.0 (MINOR bump for backward-compatible feature), cannot overwrite 1.0.0
eval_cases.prompt: Update the existing SAR application arn:aws:serverlessrepo:us-east-1:123456789012:apps/s3-file-processor from version 1.0.0 to 1.1.0. The update adds a new optional parameter MemorySize (backward-compatible). README updated. Packaged template ready. Author: Jacky Chan. Region us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SAR_APPLICATION: s3-file-processor (1.1.0)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Semantic version: 1.1.0 (MINOR bump from 1.0.0 — backward-compatible)
  [✓] Previous version 1.0.0 preserved (immutable)
  [✓] New parameter: MemorySize (optional, Number, default 256)
  [✓] README.md: updated
  [✓] Packaged template: ready (S3-backed CodeUri)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws serverlessrepo get-application --application-id arn:aws:serverlessrepo:us-east-1:123456789012:apps/s3-file-processor --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Public SAR application without LICENSE (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — public app requires LICENSE; file is missing
eval_cases.prompt: Publish a serverless application named event-router as PUBLIC. SAM template with AWS::Serverless::Function. README.md present. No LICENSE file (it was never created). Semantic version 1.0.0. Author: Jacky Chan. Region us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SAR_APPLICATION: event-router
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] LICENSE: MISSING — required for PUBLIC sharing; the SAR API rejects public publishes without a LICENSE file
